author: Bellular News
description:
Blizzard is reportedly Xbox's best-performing studio, and a huge BlizzCon could give Microsoft plenty of reasons to keep investing. With the rest of Xbox struggling, I think Blizzard is trying to make itself as hard to cut as possible. Even that might not be enough if Call of Duty has another bad year.
